description: Eight habitats in a line, each adapting to its own point on an environmental gradient, with mutation and neighbour migration shaping where the traits step and where the population can hold on.

params.text: Sets the speed evolution runs at, -8 to +4 octaves, giving 4 units of evolutionary time per second at the centre.
Sets how hard each habitat is pulled toward its own optimum, 0 to 1 on the knob, mapped to a selection strength of 8 times the square of that.
Sets the mutation diffusion through trait space: exactly zero at the bottom, then 0.00001 to 0.003 per unit of evolutionary time on a logarithmic scale.
Sets the migration between neighbouring habitats: exactly zero at the bottom, then 0.002 to 2 per unit of evolutionary time on a logarithmic scale.
Sets the slope of the environmental gradient, -0.85 to +0.85 trait units; the optimum of habitat 8 differs from habitat 1 by twice this, and positive values favour higher traits toward habitat 8.
Closes the migration link between habitats 4 and 5, 0 to 1, with a permeability of one minus the setting squared; 0 leaves it open and 1 shuts it exactly.
Adds a shared offset to all eight environmental optima, -0.85 to +0.85 trait units.
Restores the deterministic starting field at the current gradient and climate, and clears the event state.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the selection strength.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the mutation diffusion.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the migration.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the gradient slope.
An attenuverter, -1 to +1, scaling the CV into the central barrier.
Chooses Row, which links habitats 1 through 8 in a line so the two end habitats have one neighbour each, or Ring, which adds an 8 to 1 link and gives every habitat two.

inputs.text: Doubles the speed evolution runs at for every volt, added to the RATE knob, with the two together clamped to -12 through +4 octaves.
Modulates the selection strength, a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the mutation diffusion, a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the migration, a tenth of the knob's range per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the gradient slope, a tenth per volt through its attenuverter.
Modulates the central barrier, a tenth per volt through its attenuverter.
Adds 0.1 trait units per volt to the shared climate offset, with the total clamped to -0.85 through +0.85; there is no attenuverter on this one.
A rising edge past 1V restores the deterministic starting field.

outputs.text: Eight channels of local mean trait, one per habitat, at 2V per trait unit and spanning -2V to +2V; a channel freezes at its last value while its habitat is empty.
Eight channels of local population mass, one per habitat, 0 to 10V; this is what says whether a habitat is occupied at all.
The abundance-weighted mean trait across all eight habitats, at 2V per trait unit and spanning -2V to +2V.
The trait mean of habitats 5 to 8 minus that of habitats 1 to 4, at 2V per trait difference and spanning -4V to +4V.
The current migration activity between neighbours, unsigned and normalised to 0 to 10V.
A 10V pulse 1ms long when any habitat becomes occupied.
A 10V pulse 1ms long when any habitat stops being occupied.

notes: The barrier only ever closes the link between habitats 4 and 5. In Row that cuts the line into two groups of four; in Ring, migration travels the other way round instead.
There is no step input: the field is a continuous ecology, and a knob or CV change alters what happens next without redrawing the population already on screen.
The screen draws the eight habitats left to right as stacked trait distributions, with the line through them tracking each local mean.
